ucs.title: [LLM] Turla (Snake/Secret Blizzard) ComRAT/Kazuar fileless loader — scheduled task → PowerShell reflectively loads registry-stored blob
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's signature fileless persistence chain where a scheduled task (or svchost-spawned service) launches PowerShell that reads an encrypted .NET payload from a registry value and reflectively loads it in memory — the loader pattern documented for ComRAT v4 and the Kazuar backdoor. Tied to G0010's heavy, repeated combination of T1053.005 + T1059.001 + T1112 + in-memory .NET loading rather than dropping an EXE.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("svchost.exe","taskeng.exe","schtasks.exe","services.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*Get-ItemProperty*" OR Processes.process="*GetValue*" OR Processes.process="*HKLM*" OR Processes.process="*HKCU*") AND (Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*Reflection.Assembly*" OR Processes.process="*[Reflection.Assembly]::Load*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke*" OR Processes.process="*::Load(*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("svchost.exe","taskeng.exe","schtasks.exe","services.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Get-ItemProperty","GetValue","HKLM","HKCU",":\\Registry")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","Reflection.Assembly","[Reflection.Assembly]::Load","::Load(","Invoke")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("svchost.exe","taskeng.exe","schtasks.exe","services.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Get-ItemProperty","GetValue","HKLM","HKCU")
| where CommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","Reflection.Assembly","[Reflection.Assembly]::Load","::Load(","Invoke")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla ComRAT/Kazuar PowerShell Reflective Load From Registry Blob
id: 9a3c7d12-4f6b-4d2a-9b21-7e0f8c1a55d2
status: experimental
description: Detects scheduled-task / service-spawned PowerShell that reads a registry value and reflectively loads .NET assembly, matching Turla (G0010) ComRAT v4 and Kazuar fileless loaders
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\svchost.exe'
      - '\taskeng.exe'
      - '\schtasks.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_reg:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Get-ItemProperty'
      - 'GetValue'
      - 'HKLM'
      - 'HKCU'
  selection_load:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Reflection.Assembly'
      - '::Load('
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_reg and selection_load
falsepositives:
  - Endpoint management agents that stage signed code from registry
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\svchost.exe OR *\Svchost.exe OR *\taskeng.exe OR *\schtasks.exe OR *\services.exe OR *\Services.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*Get-ItemProperty* OR *GetValue* OR *HKLM* OR *HKCU*) AND @CommandLine:(*FromBase64String* OR *Reflection.Assembly* OR *::Load(*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(svchost|taskeng|schtasks|services)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(Get-ItemProperty|GetValue|HKLM|HKCU)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(FromBase64String|Reflection\.Assembly|::Load\()", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Generic PowerShell hunting fires constantly; this binds three Turla-characteristic constraints together — a service/scheduled-task parent (their persistence vector), registry-value read (ComRAT/Kazuar store the encrypted payload in the registry rather than on disk), and in-memory .NET reflective load. That exact triad is documented G0010 tradecraft and rare in benign tooling.
_sigma_issues: no MITRE ATT&CK tag (expected at least one `attack.t####`)

ucs.title: [LLM] Turla web-service C2 — non-browser process beaconing to webmail/legit cloud (ComRAT Gmail, Snake/Carbon cloud relays)
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's hallmark abuse of legitimate web and webmail services for command-and-control — ComRAT v4 drives C2 through the Gmail web UI, and Snake/Carbon/Kazuar relay through hijacked legitimate sites and cloud storage. Flags a non-browser executable making HTTPS to webmail/cloud endpoints (mail.google.com, OneDrive, pCloud, Yandex), which a normal user reaches only via a browser. Tied to G0010's documented T1071.003 / T1102.002 usage.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,80)) AND (All_Traffic.app="*mail.google.com*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mail.google.com*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*onedrive*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*pcloud.com*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*yandex*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*api.dropboxapi.com*") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where NOT process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","OneDrive.exe","Dropbox.exe") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","OneDrive.exe","Dropbox.exe","msteams.exe","olk.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let WebSvc = dynamic(["mail.google.com","onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","pcloud.com","api.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","disk.yandex.com"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (WebSvc)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), Beacons = count(), Urls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 10)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| where Beacons >= 3   // 3 = strip one-off cert/telemetry pings; tune per env
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","OneDrive.exe","Dropbox.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let WebSvc = dynamic(["mail.google.com","onedrive.live.com","pcloud.com","dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","disk.yandex.com"]);
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where isnotempty(DstHostname)
| where DstHostname has_any (WebSvc)
| extend Proc = tostring(split(SrcUsername,"\\")[-1])
| where SrcProcessName !in~ (Browsers)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Beacons = count(), Hosts = make_set(DstHostname,10)
          by DvcHostname, SrcProcessName, SrcUsername
| where Beacons >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*mail.google.com* OR *onedrive.live.com* OR *pcloud.com* OR *dropboxapi.com* OR *cloud-api.yandex.net* OR *disk.yandex.com*) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\outlook.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mail\.google\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|pcloud\.com|dropboxapi\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|disk\.yandex\.com)/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|onedrive|dropbox|outlook)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count >= 3
ucs.rationale: Most APTs hide in raw IP or domain-fronted C2; Turla specifically tunnels C2 through the human-facing webmail/cloud UIs (ComRAT's Gmail-web-interface channel is a published, near-unique tradecraft detail). Keying on a NON-browser process reaching those exact consumer endpoints isolates the Turla pattern — a legitimate user only hits mail.google.com via a browser, never via a standalone binary or L

_sentinel_field_issues.message: `SrcProcessName` is not a canonical column of ImNetworkSession. Did you mean `SrcHostname`?
